name: reasoning-details-replay-sequence
note: Upstream 4ca636c5e+b7bb00b93. The reasoning_details sequence lives in the THINKING block's thinkingSignature and is replayed verbatim, in order, across all three detail shapes (text/encrypted/summary) with their id/format/index fields intact. The sequence also wins over the legacy single encrypted detail still sitting on the tool call's thoughtSignature. Post-0.84.2 surface, so backend is src: REQUIRES PI_UPSTREAM_SHA >= b7bb00b93 (at an older pin pi still replays the pre-b7bb00b93 shape and this FAILs). Key order inside each detail is declared order-sensitive: OpenRouter wants the sequence back unmodified, and without the declaration the harness sorts keys before diffing, so the order.txt lines for these paths would be written and compared against nothing. Shipped in pi-ai 0.84.3 (release 4e58f324f); flipped to backend:"dist" — the published build is the stronger ground truth (README rule).
